Rule.name: Export-TaskResult-Report
Rule.Description:
Export a TaskResult Jasper report to CSV and PDFusing the same rendering path as the Task Result UI export.
Arguments: taskResultNamePrefix - TaskResult name. If a partial name is provided, the first TaskResult with a name that starts with this prefix will be used. csvOutPath - Output file path for CSV export. Leave blank or null to skip CSV export. pdfOutPath - Output file path for PDF export. Leave blank or null to skip PDF export.
Import and run (IIQ console): import examples/rules/Export-TaskResult-Report.xml rule Export-TaskResult-Report
